entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Neutral Citation No. - 2024:Ahc-Lko:81094
Court No. - 20

Case :- Application U/S 482 No. - 2102 of 2016
Applicant :- Ranno And Another
Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another

Counsel for Applicant :- Sheo Prakash Singh
Counsel for Opposite Party :- Govt. Advocate,Amar Singh,Dinesh Kumar Pandey,Jay Narayan 
Hon'ble Arvind Singh Sangwan,J.
1.

This petition has been filed with the prayer to quash the impugned charge sheet No. 260 of 2015 in Case Crime No. 350 of 2014 under Sections 498A, 323, 504 and 506 of IPC and Section 3/4 of Dowry Prohibition Act at Police Station - Thakur Ganj, District - Lucknow, and all the consequential proceedings pending before ACJM CBI (Ayodhya Prakhand), Lucknow.
2. Learned Counsel for the petitioners submits that both the petitioners are the sisters-in-law of the informant (sisters of husband of the informant Amit Kumar).
It is stated that their marriage took place prior to the marriage of the informant with Amit Kumar and they were living separately and are separate in mess.
It is argued that they have been roped in just to put pressure on the entire family.
3. Counsel submits that without verifying the aforesaid facts, the charge-sheet has been submitted against the petitioners.
The State has filed short counter affidavit through A.C.P., Chowk, Lucknow and has stated that allegations in the petition are wrong.
This petition is pending since 2016 and till date, no counter affidavit has been filed by the informant.
Ranno And Another vs State Of U.P. And Another on 5 December, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/132808017/

entities.text: Ranno And Another vs State Of U.P. And Another
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 1 4. Vide order dated 12.4.2016, the arrest of the petitioners was stayed.

It is submitted that till date,
no further action was taken by the Trial Court against the petitioners and the husband is facing trial.
5.

Counsel has relied upon the decision in Geeta Mehrotra and Another vs. State of Uttar Pradesh and Another, (2012) 10 SCC 741, wherein the Supreme Court has held that in a matrimonial dispute,
a casual reference to the family members of the husband i.e. the sisters-in-law as co-accused, the proceedings can be quashed.
6. Similar view has been taken in Criminal Appeal No. 195 of 2022 (Kahkashan Kausar @ Sonam &
Ors. Vs. State of Bihar & Others) decided on 8.2.2024, wherein the Supreme Court has quashed the criminal proceedings against the family members of the husband who were mother-in-law,
sister-in-law and brother-in-law.
7.

entities.text: Geeta Mehrotra and Another vs. State of Uttar Pradesh and Another, (2012) 10 SCC 741
entities.label: PRECEDENT

entities.text:
Kahkashan Kausar @ Sonam &
Ors. Vs. State of Bihar & Others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
Reliance has also been placed upon the decision in Criminal Appeal No. 2379 of 2024 (Achin Gupta Vs. State of Haryana and Another) decided on 3rd May, 2024, wherein the Supreme Court,
after considering the earlier judgments, has quashed the criminal proceedings against the family members of the husband.
8.

entities.text: Criminal Appeal No. 2379 of 2024 (Achin Gupta Vs. State of Haryana and Another)
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: As noticed above, no counter has been filed by opposite party No.2 and in the short counter affidavit of the State, the specific allegations made by the petitioners that they are the married sisters-in-law and are separate in mess, are not denied.
9. Accordingly, in terms of the judgments of the Supreme Court referred herein above, this petition is allowed.
The impugned order, the impugned F.I.R. and all consequential proceedings so far as they relate to the petitioners herein are quashed.
